justification: GST-4097 deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run (CREW rule 15): every reviewer brief in review/sections/adversarial.md and review/sections/review-army.md is byte-identical to main 778934c0 (the Claude adversarial subagent prompt, 2338 bytes; the Codex outside prompt, 1464 bytes; the structured-review request; the Red Team prompt, 655 bytes; the specialist prompt block, 4606 bytes), compared by extracting each quoted brief from both revisions. What changed is how standalone /review runs the Codex passes and who it dispatches, never what a reviewer reads: the two inline Codex shell blocks become one bin/gstack-outside-voice call (the codex-cli runner, same codex exec flags, same lib/outside-review-result.ts classification, the structured pass appends the same REPOSITORY CONTEXT diff bytes), which prints its own OUTSIDE_STATUS line; the Codex pass is no longer called optional; and on diffs over 200 lines red-team is named on the specialist selection line, so the Stop-hook contract requires the Red Team dispatch the section already asked for. Coverage can only rise: no reviewer, step, depth rule or severity rule is removed, and /gstack-ship's sections are unchanged. Reasoning effort keeps the same precedence: the helper gets --effort high as the gate default and resolves it through gstack-codex-probe check-effort, so GSTACK_CODEX_EFFORT and codex_effort still override it.
